caption: The video captures a sandy, beach-like setting where a black plastic train track is laid in a winding S-curve across the grains. A weathered wooden post stands at the left edge and a small dark twig is stuck in the sand near the upper bend, both remaining fixed throughout. The track lies empty for the opening portion before a gray LEGO vehicle carrying a minifigure with a yellow head, red cap and red torso slides into view from the bottom-right corner. The vehicle then travels continuously along the rails, following the curve from the foreground toward the upper-middle of the scene. Its orientation turns with each bend of the track, and its apparent size steadily diminishes as it recedes into the distance. Slight motion blur accompanies the movement, while the sand, post and track stay in the same positions. The vehicle is still progressing along the far curve.
